title: Breaking Through the Ivory Tower of High-Indexed Journals: Insights from EFL Academics in Private Universities, East Java, Indonesia
core_idea: Assess the productivity levels and identify the barriers EFL academics at private universities in East Java face when publishing in Scopus- and Web of Science-indexed journals, using a sequential explanatory mixed-methods design (SINTA database analysis, online survey, and interviews) to inform strategies for improving publication success.
tldr: A mixed-methods study examining publication productivity and barriers for EFL academics in East Java private universities regarding Scopus/WoS journals, aiming to inform strategies to improve publication outcomes.
